priority_items.title: FLASH: CCG-21585 rammed BFAR BRP Datu Magat Salamat near Palawan; hull damage, no injuries; CCG blames PH course change
priority_items.summary: PCG (Tarriela via GMA 13:56 PHT; Reuters/ST): CCG hull 21585 made a ~10 m stern pass at 11:04 PHT then rammed BRP Datu Magat Salamat at 11:13 PHT (03:13 UTC) ~6.36 NM NNW of Abad Santos Shoal, ~54 NM off Palawan, during a fuel-subsidy mission. Starboard railings/stanchions/deck fixtures damaged; debris on deck; no injuries. PCG: 'deliberately rammed a civilian government vessel.' Commandant Gavan ordered surface/air assets to assist. CCG (ST 14:33 SGT update): law enforcement near Sabina Shoal; PH vessel ignored warnings, altered course, cut across CCG bow; China 'professional.' Same BFAR hull grounded Thursday at Hasa-Hasa and was refloated — context, not a second FLASH. No shots fired. No emergency AMM printed.
